Gigabyte B860 EAGLE WiFi 6E Motherboard Specifications

​The Gigabyte B860 EAGLE WiFi 6E is a feature-rich, mainstream motherboard designed for the latest generation of Intel Core processors. It strikes a balance between high-end connectivity, including the ultra-fast WiFi 6E standard, and robust power delivery for stable performance in gaming and professional workloads.

​Core Specifications

  • ​Socket: Intel® Socket LGA 1851 / 1700 (Depending on specific CPU generation support)
  • ​Chipset: Intel® B860
  • ​Form Factor: ATX
  • ​CPU Support: Supports Intel® Core™ Ultra processors and 14th/13th/12th Gen Intel® Core™ processors (depending on the specific socket revision).

​Memory Support

  • ​Slots: 4 x DDR5 DIMM
  • ​Max Capacity: Up to 192GB (48GB per slot)
  • ​Architecture: Dual Channel
  • ​Speeds: Supports up to 8000+(OC) MHz with XMP 3.0 profiles.

​Expansion & Storage

  • ​PCIe Slots:
    • ​1 x PCIe 5.0 x16 (Primary reinforced slot for GPUs)
    • ​2 x PCIe 3.0/4.0 x1 slots
  • ​M.2 Slots: * 3 x M.2 slots (Key M) supporting PCIe 4.0 x4 performance.
  • ​SATA Ports: 4 x SATA 6Gb/s ports.

​Connectivity & Networking

  • ​Wireless: Wi-Fi 6E (802.11ax) with 6GHz band support and Bluetooth 5.3.
  • ​Ethernet: 1 x Realtek® 2.5GbE LAN port.
  • ​Rear I/O Ports:
    • ​1 x USB 3.2 Gen 2 (Type-C)
    • ​1 x USB 3.2 Gen 2 (Type-A)
    • ​4 x USB 2.0/1.1
    • ​1 x HDMI 2.1 / 1 x DisplayPort 1.4
    • ​3 x Audio Jacks

​Internal Features & Cooling

  • ​Digital VRM Design: 12+1+1 phases for stable power delivery under heavy loads.
  • ​M.2 Thermal Guard: Heatsinks included for M.2 slots to prevent throttling of high-speed NVMe SSDs.
  • ​Smart Fan 6: Multiple temperature sensors and hybrid fan headers with FAN STOP technology.
  • ​Q-Flash Plus: Update the BIOS without installing the CPU, memory, or graphics card.

​Key Highlights

  • ​WiFi 6E Technology: Access to the 6GHz frequency band ensures lower latency and less interference in crowded wireless environments.
  • ​DDR5 Optimized: Enhanced circuitry to unlock the full potential of high-frequency DDR5 memory modules.
  • ​PCIe 5.0 Ready: Future-proofed for the next generation of high-end graphics cards with double the bandwidth of PCIe 4.0.
  • ​Advanced Thermal Design: Large VRM heatsinks and optimized airflow paths ensure the motherboard stays cool during intense gaming or rendering sessions.
